summary: The Department revised the final environmental statement to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles, citing the U.S. Mining Law of 1872 and recognizing the importance of the mining, oil, and gas industry's access to public lands without undue restrictions.
text: As a result of the comments received from the mining interests and further consideration given to this subject by the Department, its proposed actions have been revised. In the final environmental statement, under the definition of off-road vehicles, the Department has excepted mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment, as provided for under the specific provisions contained in the Departmental regulations governing off-road vehicle use. These exceptions are authorized under the U.S. Mining Law of 1872 (Chapter 152, "An Act to Promote the Development of the Mining Resources of the United States," U.S. Statutes, Approved May 10, 1872, pp. 91-96. Also, 1873, Chapter 159, Post, U.S. Statutes, p. 465.)
